title: The experimental `bstr` module should be called `b_str`
author: retrokp
body_preview: The stable modules [`os_str`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/ffi/os_str/index.html) and [`c_str`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/ffi/c_str/index.html) have an underscore in their names. For consistency, [`bstr`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/bstr/index.html) should be `b_str`.
